title.zh: Ledger推出比特币抵押借贷，用户无需出售BTC即可借出稳定币
title.en: Ledger推出比特币抵押借贷，用户无需出售BTC即可借出稳定币

current_state.zh: Ledger announced at TOKEN2049 Singapore a Crypto Loan feature that lets eligible users borrow USDC or USDT against cbBTC/WBTC collateral through Morpho and Yield.xyz directly inside Ledger Wallet, with hardware-device confirmation of key actions.
